creator: Claude Opus 5

the_revision.what: All four shipped personalities rewritten across the fourteen headings. Coverage went from 3, 3, 3 and 5 of thirteen to fourteen of fourteen each.
the_revision.cards: Friendly Guide 22, Tech Agent 23, BubblyBetty 20, Dad Joke Dan 27 including eight jokes.
the_revision.generated_from_one_source: Document and workshop cards are generated from the same data, so a Save in the designer recompiles to what is already stored. Before this, a personality whose document had cards the workshop did not would lose them on the first Save.
the_revision.nothing_deleted: Seven Tech cards and three BubblyBetty cards existed in the workshop and never reached their documents — popper, one_reality, tell_the_truth, kind, open_continue for Tech; nervous_system, relax, sales_host for Betty. All are in the documents now.
the_revision.frequency_words_computed: Every frequency line is computed from its own card's gain, never typed, so the two cannot disagree.
the_revision.absolutes_are_rare: Two cards per personality carry always — identity under probe, and the one real prohibition. Nothing carries never.
the_revision.jokes: Five new jokes from the Captain. Eight total, on the Tone shelf at 45.1 to 45.8, gain 70 — regularly, 85%. Format is his: Joke set up — "..." then Punchline — "...".
the_revision.clouds_emptied: The cloud groupings named cards that no longer exist after the rewrite, and they compile as their own sections. The fourteen headings are the grouping now.

gate_updated: check_personality_document.php knows Personalization is the fourteenth slot — it is not seeded in SOUL_LAYERS, the compiler pushes it in at density 1 — so a document carrying it no longer fails.
gate_moved: check_php_string_literals.php: all four hashes moved with the approved text, in this commit.

IMPORTANT_for_testing.defaults_do_not_overwrite: flosc_personality_library_get_all() seeds the shipped defaults only when the wp_options row does not exist. dainis.net already has that row, so installing this zip will NOT change the four personalities there.
IMPORTANT_for_testing.how_to_force_a_reseed: wp option delete flosc_personality_library --path=/home/dainisne/public_html   then load any FLOSC admin page. This destroys any personality edited on that site, which is why it is a manual step and not code.
